title: Image and 3D generation get sturdier
summary:
Z-Image got a fallback, community image models got a leaderboard, and the app catalog got both new arrivals and a tidy-up.

Z-Image gained a fallback to Fal when its primary pool returns a 503 or network error. Its worker queue now caps waiting requests so overflow can reach that fallback instead of piling up. Trellis 2 moved to async provider jobs while keeping the Pollinations 3D API response synchronous and preserving resolution options.

Community-model monitoring now probes both text and image generation. A daily reliability audit accounts for recent recovery and successful fallbacks, and a new community image-model leaderboard reports volume, median generation time, and success rate.

The showcase added Tessera Lumen for writing, INKRUSH for making multi-panel comics, and FlashcardGeneratorAI for interactive study cards. All three come from community builders.
